name: optotype-geometry
citation: ISO 8596:2017 Ophthalmic optics — Visual acuity testing — Standard and clinical optotypes and their presentation (Landolt ring reference; Sloan/Snellen letters drawn on a 5 × 5 stroke grid). The 20/20 (decimal 1.0, logMAR 0) letter has a 1 arcmin stroke and a 5 arcmin height at the eye.
note: A definition, not a measurement; not checked against the standard's text in this session (no document access).
